mapper.sql: AND EXISTS ( SELECT id FROM ( SELECT id FROM T_ENTRUST UNION ALL SELECT id FROM T_INTEGRATED_ENTRUST UNION ALL SELECT id FROM T_ENTRUSTHISTORY UNION ALL SELECT id FROM T_INTEGRATED_ENTRUSTHISTORY) T WHERE T.id = temp.TRADE_ID) AND EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM SETTLE_TRANS_DATA a left join T_ENTRUST b on LTRIM(substr(a.APPLY_TRADE_ID, 5, length(a.APPLY_TRADE_ID)), '0') = b.broker_ENTRUST_ID OR a.APPLY_TRADE_ID = b.BROKER_ENTRUST_ID left join T_INTEGRATED_ENTRUST c on LTRIM(substr(a.APPLY_TRADE_ID, 5, length(a.APPLY_TRADE_ID)), '0') = c.broker_ENTRUST_ID OR a.APPLY_TRADE_ID = c.BROKER_ENTRUST_ID left join T_ENTRUSTHISTORY d on LTRIM(substr(a.APPLY_TRADE_ID, 5, length(a.APPLY_TRADE_ID)), '0') = d.broker_ENTRUST_ID OR a.APPLY_TRADE_ID = d.BROKER_ENTRUST_ID left join T_INTEGRATED_ENTRUSTHISTORY e on LTRIM(substr(a.APPLY_TRADE_ID, 5, length(a.APPLY_TRADE_ID)), '0') = e.broker_ENTRUST_ID OR a.APPLY_TRADE_ID = e.BROKER_ENTRUST_ID WHERE b.id is not null or c.ID is not null or d.ID is not null or e.ID is not NULL and (b.id = TEMP.TRADE_ID or c.id = TEMP.TRADE_ID or d.id = TEMP.TRADE_ID or e.id = TEMP.TRADE_ID))

mapper.select: SELECT fdp.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID, fdp.PLEDGE_NUMBER PLEDGE_NUMBER, fdp.PLEDGE_RATIO PLEDGE_RATIO, fdp.PLEDGE_AMT PLEDGE_AMT, fdp.FINPROD_ID FROM FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE fdp where fdp.FINPROD_ID = #{skuId}

SELECT case when tpd.PS = 'T49' then tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID else tpd.TRADE_ID end TRADE_ID, tpda.ENTRUST_ID ENTRUST_ID, tpd.FINPROD_TYPE2 FINPROD_TYPE2, tpd.PS PS, tpd.FINPROD_ID FINPROD_ID, tpd.COUNTER_ID COUNTER_ID, tpd.CCY CCY, tpd.TRADE_AMT TRADE_AMT, tpd.SHARE_AMT SHARE_AMT, tpd.UNIT_CPRICE UNIT_CPRICE, tpd.TRADE_DATE TRADE_DATE, #{YES_OR_NO_N} isBottom, tfpb.FINPROD_ID zhaiZhuanGuId, tfpb.SHARE_AMT zhaiZhuanGuNum, tfpb.UNIT_CPRICE zhaiZhuanGuDanJia FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD tpda ON tpda.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT ftp on ftp.FINPROD_ID = tpd.FINPROD_ID and ftp.BRANCH= '0' left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on fpt.FINPROD_ID=ftp.FINPROD_ID and fpt.BRANCH=ftp.BRANCH left join trd_fin_product_barter tfpb on tfpb.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID where tpd.TRADE_MARKET in (#{TRADE_PLACE_03},#{TRADE_PLACE_04}) and tpd.TRADE_DATE = to_date(#{executeDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') and tpd.TRADE_STATUS = #{status} and tpd.IS_CANCEL = #{YES_OR_NO_N} and ( (tpd.PS not in ('T11','T12','T13','T09','T08','T07','T39') and tpd.FINPROD_TYPE2 not in ('F10','F01','F02','F03')) or (tpd.FINPROD_TYPE2 in ('F10','F01') and tpd.PS not in ('T05','T11','T12','T13','T39','T22')) or (tpd.FINPROD_TYPE2 in ('F02','F03') and tpd.PS = 'T01' and fpt.type_7 = 'H01') )

SELECT rvas.FINPROD_ID finprodId, fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodType2, fp.CCY ccy, CASE WHEN fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01' THEN rvas.SECURITY_QUANTITY*temp.AMOUNT/rvsas.SECURITY_QUANTITY ELSE rvas.smv*temp.AMOUNT/rvsas.SECURITY_QUANTITY END shareAmt, CASE WHEN fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01' THEN rvas.SECURITY_QUANTITY*temp.AMOUNT/rvsas.SECURITY_QUANTITY ELSE rvas.smv*temp.AMOUNT/rvsas.SECURITY_QUANTITY END tradeAmt, temp.FINPROD_ID pFinprodId, #{YES_OR_NO_Y} isBottom, to_date(#{executeDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') tradeDate, #{ps} ps FROM ( SELECT psp.PORTFOLIO_ID, psp.FINPROD_ID, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, psp.CDATE, SUM(psp.AMOUNT) AMOUNT FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION psp INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON fp.FINPROD_ID = psp.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AND pp.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = #{PORTFOLIO_TYPE_02} where psp.CDATE = to_date(#{executeDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') GROUP BY psp.PORTFOLIO_ID,psp.FINPROD_ID, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID,psp.CDATE) temp INNER JOIN RSK_VALTBL_SUM_ASSET_SUB rvsas ON rvsas.PTL_ID = temp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AND rvsas.VAL_DATE = temp.CDATE and rvsas.SUB_CODE = '601' INNER JOIN RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB rvas ON rvas.PTL_ID = rvsas.PTL_ID AND rvas.VAL_DATE = rvsas.VAL_DATE AND rvas.FINPROD_ID IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON fp.FINPROD_ID = rvas.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT tpd on rvas.FINPROD_ID=tpd.FINPROD_ID and tpd.BRANCH='0' and tpd.FINPROD_TYPE2 not in ('F02','F04','F08')
